name: What We Speak
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power of our words, showing that the tongue holds the authority to bring life or death, justification or condemnation. Believers are called to guard their speech carefully, recognizing that careless words can lead to destruction, while godly words reflect the meditation of a heart aligned with the Lord. Yet, the tongue is inherently difficult to control, described as an unruly and dangerous instrument, underscoring the need for reliance on Christ, our strength and redeemer, to speak words pleasing to God.
